VABCD is a pyramid with a square base ABCD of side 10 cm.
The four sloping edges are each 13 cm and M is the midpoint of AB.

parts.t: Calculate the length of the diagonal AC. Give your answer correct to 3 significant figures.
Calculate the vertical height of the pyramid. Give your answer correct to 3 significant figures.

sols: The vertex V is directly above the centre of the square, which is the midpoint of AC.
the pyramid is symmetrical, since all four sloping edges are equal
Pythagoras' theorem in the right-angled triangle formed by the height, half the diagonal and a sloping edge
M is the midpoint of AB, so MB = 5 cm.
Triangle VMB has a right angle at M, because triangle VAB is isosceles with VA = VB.
